en.quote: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
en.riddle: Hath God said: Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?
en.speaker: the serpent

he.quote: וְהַנָּחָשׁ הָיָה עָרוּם מִכֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל-הָאִשָּׁה אַף כִּי-אָמַר אֱלֹהִים, לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִכֹּל עֵץ הַגָּן?
he.riddle: אַף כִּי-אָמַר אֱלֹהִים, לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִכֹּל עֵץ הַגָּן?
he.speaker: הַנָּחָשׁ

en.quote: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
en.riddle: she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
en.speaker: the man

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר הָֽאָדָם הָֽאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה עִמָּדִי הִוא נָתְנָה-לִּי מִן-הָעֵץ וָאֹכֵל.
he.speaker: הָאָדָם

en.quote: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
en.riddle: What is this thou hast done?
en.speaker: The LORD God

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לָאִשָּׁה מַה-זֹּאת עָשִׂית; וַתֹּאמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה הַנָּחָשׁ הִשִּׁיאַנִי וָאֹכֵֽל
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהִים
